name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-73570 — Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS). Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 24 August.

items.title: How to compromise your system with a job interview
items.dek: Social engineering via job interview process used to extract credentials and deploy backdoors; techniques applicable to threat modeling.
items.unproven: whether the attack method described is novel or a systematization of known social-engineering patterns

items.title: Counterexamples to the fractional coloring conjecture for triply efficient shadow tomography
items.dek: Counterexamples disprove fractional coloring conjecture for Pauli shadow tomography; theoretical quantum information with no security practice impact.
items.unproven: applicability to deployed quantum systems; relevance to cryptographic or application security workflows

items.title: Squeezed- and coherent-state quantum key distribution over a deployed hybrid fibre-free-space channel
items.authors: Dnan A. E. Hajomer et al.
items.dek: Continuous-variable QKD over deployed hybrid fibre-free-space links demonstrates adaptive post-processing; early-stage, no evidence of adoption in financial infrastructure.
items.unproven: real-world deployment beyond testbed; integration with production key management; resistance to side-channel attacks in operational settings

items.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
items.dek: EchoCoT extracts hidden chain-of-thought traces from frontier reasoning models via API fidelity signals, achieving 66% near-verbatim extraction on open-source models.
items.unproven: Does not establish extraction success rates for frontier models with sufficient detail, or defense mechanisms deployed by providers; lab conditions do not confirm real-world extraction difficulty.

items.title: COPA: Continual Preference Optimization for Adaptive Prompt Injection Defense
items.dek: COPA applies continual preference optimization to prompt injection defense, using margin-weighted replay to retain robustness against prior attacks while adapting to new ones.
items.unproven: Does not establish scalability beyond synthetic attack distributions, absence of gradient inversion leakage, or deployment without retraining cost; test attacks are researcher-designed, not adversary-evolved.

items.title: Tracking the Trend in How Speech Synthesizers Deceive People
items.dek: Human detection of synthetic speech from 2024 synthesizers (ElevenLabs) drops to 48% F1; partial spoofs achieve 9% accuracy and 77% false negatives.
items.unproven: Does not establish whether listener training or segmental detection improves these metrics; sample of 82 IT professionals does not represent general population or audio forensic practitioners.

items.title: Building an (almost) fully self-hosted, sandboxed, agentic software factory
items.dek: Self-hosted sandboxed agent architecture for software development workflow automation.
items.unproven: sandboxing effectiveness and threat model not demonstrated; no data on what "almost" self-hosted means or what escapes remain

items.title: Group-theoretic treatment of strong light-matter coupling with an arbitrary number of excitations
items.dek: Tavis-Cummings model extended to arbitrary excitations using group theory; new many-excitation polariton behavior derived.
items.unproven: purely theoretical; no experimental validation; entirely outside reader's remit

items.title: A Protocol for Shielding-Enhanced Loading of Single Polar Molecules into Optical Tweezers
items.authors: Reuben R. W. Wang et al.
items.dek: Shielding scheme isolates single polar molecules in optical tweezers with 99% fidelity using electric and microwave fields.
items.unproven: quantum physics research; no security relevance; entirely outside reader's remit

items.title: Proper Learning of Shallow All-to-All Quantum Circuits
items.dek: Learning shallow all-to-all quantum circuits; theoretical result on learnability transition with no implications for post-quantum crypto migration or agent security in SDLC.
items.unproven: tested only on random circuit ensembles; unclear relevance to actual quantum cryptographic schemes in deployment

items.title: Chameleon: Robust Defense Against Tor Website Fingerprinting via Many-to-Many Traffic Morphing
items.dek: Traffic morphing defense against Tor website fingerprinting uses many-to-many mapping and pluggable transport synchronization to increase adversarial uncertainty.
items.unproven: Does not establish defense against adversaries with fine-grained timing or traffic observation outside the PT layer, or real-world latency and throughput cost at scale.

items.title: Reinforcement LearningtoHarness Approximation Errors for Long-Time QuantumSimulation
items.dek: Reinforcement learning optimizes Trotter step sizes to correct quantum simulation errors; early-stage research without deployment evidence.
items.unproven: scalability to production quantum systems; applicability beyond small test cases

items.title: Preparation of Large Fock States in Resonators with High Probability
items.authors: Lucas R. S. Santos et al.
items.dek: Protocol for preparing large Fock states in circuit-QED with high probability; quantum hardware research outside application security remit.
items.unproven: practical implementation at scale; relevance to production systems

items.title: Privacy-Preserving Detection of Rare Disease-Associated Cell Subsets via Secure Multi-Party Computation
items.dek: Secure multi-party computation framework trains CellCnn for rare disease detection on secret-shared single-cell data without exposing raw values.
items.unproven: Does not establish computational cost at multi-institution scale, generalization beyond two benchmark datasets, or practical deployment timelines in regulated settings.

items.title: Auditing Cross-Lingual Fairness in Language Model Watermarking
items.dek: Cross-lingual fairness audit of LLM watermarking on 11 languages reveals detection and quality disparity driven by typological family, not language alone.
items.unproven: Does not establish whether observed disparities constitute deployable security issues or propose remediation; evaluation is observational only.

items.title: QUASAR: A Quantum-Classical Neural Network for SAR Satellite Physical-Layer Authentication
items.dek: Quantum-classical hybrid network for X-band SAR satellite authentication uses 10% less training data than classical baselines.
items.unproven: Does not establish real-world deployment on actual satellites, operability beyond benchmark datasets, or that IQ phase nonlinearity capture translates to security gain in adversarial conditions.

items.title: Architecture and Compilation Co-Design for High-Rate Quantum Product Codes on Neutral Atom Arrays
items.dek: Compilation framework for quantum error correction on neutral atom arrays; engineering advance with no actionability for mid-size financial services SDLC.
items.unproven: assumes neutral atom hardware deployment and does not establish timeline for practical fault-tolerant quantum computers

items.title: The ebbs and flows of quantum learning and sensing
items.dek: Learning phase in postvariational quantum circuits; quantum dynamics measurement with no direct application to secure SDLC or cryptographic risk.

items.title: A Zoology of Quantum Turing Patterns
items.dek: Quantum Turing patterns in Lindblad lattices; pattern morphology analysis unrelated to application security, SAST tuning, or post-quantum migration.

items.title: Trustworthy mobile edge caching: a blockchain approach to mitigate malicious nodes and incentivize cache sharing
items.dek: Blockchain-based trust mechanism for mobile edge cache sharing filters malicious nodes and incentivizes participation via smart contracts.
items.unproven: Does not establish performance on high-churn node populations, gas cost viability, or defense against Byzantine colluding validators.

items.title: SAKE: Spectral Autodiff Kernel Expansion for Geometric Liouvillian Transport. A Differential-Geometric Framework for Response Transport in Quantum Dynamical Systems
items.dek: SAKE framework transports nonlinear spectroscopic response between quantum models via automatic differentiation; theoretical quantum chemistry without security implications.
items.unproven: not applicable to reader's domain

items.title: Geometric Control of Cat States in High Harmonic Generation
items.dek: High-harmonic generation can engineer cat states in light; quantum optics research unrelated to application security.
items.unproven: not applicable to reader's domain

items.title: A Meta-Study on Replication Papers in Usable Security & Privacy
items.dek: Meta-study of 24 replication papers in usable security finds no strict exact replications and vague modification reporting across venues.
items.unproven: Does not propose actionable standards, only documents current practice; assessment of whether clearer guidelines would improve research quality is absent.

items.title: TrustRAG: Blockchain-Enhanced RAG via Committee-Based Credibility Scoring
items.dek: Blockchain-backed RAG system certifies retriever documents via zero-knowledge committee scoring and secure multi-party computation.
items.unproven: Does not establish latency overhead, scalability to large document sets, or defense against compromised committee members; no comparative benchmarks against non-blockchain baselines.
